answer: The production main kernel is 102.464 us. Three low-overhead sampled traces place its all-CTA envelope at 100.704-101.344 us and measure WG2 producer cadence; the detailed phase trace remains highly perturbing, so it explains normalized overlap/order but cannot numerically partition 102.464 us.

locality_derived.unit_note: Nsight Mbyte divided by microseconds is decimal Tbyte/s.
locality_derived.interpretation: The hot set is mostly served by L1, so its lower L2 hit percentage does not mean worse overall caching; far fewer requests reach L2/HBM.

directional_ordered_section_headlines.caveat: This ordered section capture required 21 replay passes with cache/clock control disabled. Use it as directional context; the three-pass core report supplies the authoritative 102.464 us headline.

production_stall_evidence.warning: PC/PM states are directional samples from separate multi-pass profiler runs, not additive source phases.

timing_and_perturbation.warning: CUDA-event API timing and source CTA makespan are different scopes. The API includes surrounding work; the source span covers the instrumented main kernel's CTA_ENTER-to-CTA_EXIT envelope.

integrity.note: %globaltimer is the cross-SM axis. The active CTA enter-to-exit ratio is the stable clock sanity check; short adjacent landmark ratios are strongly quantized at the globaltimer tick and are diagnostic only.

busiest_cta_overlap.warning: lane_overlap_factor is summed per-lane residency divided by the union of observed lane intervals; values above 1 quantify cross-lane overlap, while 1 means no cross-lane overlap.

wg2_k_ready_to_wg0.interpretation: Producer service begins before the WG0 wait; consumer wait and producer service therefore overlap and are not additive. The cross-WG signed stamp delta is scheduling/clock granularity around a post-arrive producer stamp, not barrier latency.

wg0_score_ready_to_wg1.interpretation: WG1 waits while WG0 performs QK/softmax/publish/PV issue; the two intervals overlap and are not additive. The cross-WG signed stamp delta is scheduling/clock granularity around a post-arrive producer stamp, not barrier latency.

double_buffer_reuse.interpretation: Positive headroom means the ordinal-2 producer release occurred before the consumer entered the reuse barrier; the short barrier region is then overhead, not blocked time.

source_trace.warning: All source-trace durations are on a highly perturbed trace-on binary. Use normalized shares, ordering, and overlap only; never scale these bars onto the 102.464 us production axis.

replication.interpretation: This low-overhead two-stamp symbol supports the absolute all-CTA grid envelope and WG2 producer cadence. It does not observe WG0/WG1 or split WG2 into gather/dequant/RoPE subphases.

integrity.note: %globaltimer is the cross-SM axis. The active CTA enter-to-exit ratio is the stable clock sanity check; short adjacent landmark ratios are strongly quantized at the globaltimer tick and are diagnostic only.

wg2_cycle_distribution.warning: These cycles measure the sampled trace symbol. Use the distribution shape and normalized cadence; only compare absolute cycles with production if the measured trace-on perturbation gate passes.

sampled_wg2_trace.warning: The sampled symbol records only CTA enter/exit and WG2 tile begin/end. WG0/WG1 phase rows are intentionally absent and must not be inferred.
